description: This file declares functions related to pointwise convolution operations optimized for the xpu backend within the ATen library, part of PyTorch. It includes function prototypes for standard and binary pointwise convolutions, with parameters for tensors, optional biases, stride, dilation, group count, attributes, and algorithms.

methods.name: convolution_pointwise
methods.description: Performs a pointwise convolution with given tensors, optional bias, padding, stride, dilation, group count, attributes, scalars, and algorithm.

methods.name: convolution_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise convolution involving two input tensors and various operation attributes.

methods.name: convolution_pointwise_binary_
methods.description: In-place binary pointwise convolution updating the 'other_t' tensor, with parameters similar to the binary function.
